articles.title: Hundreds Feared Dead After Massive Mudslide on China-Nepal Border
articles.summary: A huge mudslide struck the border area between China and Nepal on Wednesday, August 26, causing widespread destruction. Hundreds of people have been reported dead, with more than 2,000 others still missing. Rescue teams from both countries rushed to the affected areas to search for survivors buried under thick layers of mud and debris. The disaster was triggered by extremely heavy rainfall that had been soaking the mountainous region for several days. Officials warned that ongoing wet weather could make rescue efforts more dangerous and slow. The tragedy has drawn attention to how climate change may be making extreme weather events in high-altitude areas more frequent and more deadly.

lv1: What natural disaster happened near the China-Nepal border? (中國和尼泊爾邊境發生了什麼自然災害？)
How many people were reported missing after the mudslide? (泥石流發生後有多少人失蹤？)
lv2: Why do you think heavy rainfall can cause mudslides in mountainous areas? (你認為為什麼持續大雨會在山區引發泥石流？)
What challenges might rescue teams face when trying to help survivors of a mudslide? (救援人員在協助泥石流倖存者時可能面臨哪些困難？)
lv3: Some scientists say climate change is making extreme rainfall events more common. Do you agree that humans are responsible for disasters like this mudslide? Why or why not? (部分科學家認為氣候變化令極端降雨事件更頻繁。你是否同意人類需為這類災難負責？請解釋你的看法。)

When a disaster crosses two countries' borders, who should take the lead in organising the rescue — each country independently, or should international organisations step in? Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of each approach. (當災難跨越兩國邊境，應由各國自行主導救援，還是由國際組織介入？試討論兩種方式的利弊。)

articles.title: Mainland China's Top Students Flock to Hong Kong Universities as New School Year Begins
articles.summary: As Hong Kong's new school year gets underway in September 2026, universities across the city are welcoming a growing wave of top-performing students from mainland China. Reports indicate that several institutions have seen notable rises in application numbers, with admitted mainland students scoring above the top university entry lines of many Chinese provinces. Experts say Hong Kong's reputation for internationally recognised qualifications and its position as a global financial hub are key attractions. This trend reflects Hong Kong's growing appeal as a destination for talented young people from across China, and raises interesting questions about competition, diversity, and opportunity in higher education.

lv1: Where are many of the new university students in Hong Kong coming from? (香港許多新大學生來自哪裡？)
Why do you think students want to study at universities in Hong Kong? (你認為學生為什麼想在香港的大學學習？)
lv2: What advantages might Hong Kong universities offer to students from mainland China compared with universities on the mainland? (與內地大學相比，香港大學對內地學生有什麼優勢？)
How might an increase in mainland students affect local Hong Kong students' university experience? (內地生人數增加，可能如何影響本地香港學生的大學體驗？)
lv3: Is it fair for universities to admit large numbers of students from outside Hong Kong if it means fewer places for local students? Consider different perspectives including students, universities, and the government. (如果吸收大量非本地生意味著本地生名額減少，這樣做是否公平？請從學生、大學及政府等不同角度思考。)

Some people argue that attracting the brightest students from across China strengthens Hong Kong as an education hub, while others worry it reduces opportunities for local young people. Which view do you find more convincing, and why? (有人認為吸引全國頂尖學生有助鞏固香港作為教育樞紐的地位，但也有人擔心此舉減少本地年輕人的機會。你認同哪種觀點？請說明原因。)

articles.title: 全國生態日展覽今起東九文化中心開幕　帶市民認識自然保育
articles.summary: 配合全國生態日，一個以生態保育為主題的專題展覽於九月一日至六日在東九龍文化中心舉行。展覽透過互動展品及圖文介紹，讓市民深入了解本地及全國的生態環境，以及人類活動對自然界的影響。主辦方希望藉此提高公眾的環保意識，鼓勵市民在日常生活中採取更多愛護環境的行動。展覽免費開放，適合家庭及學生參觀，是假期學習的好機會。

lv1: 這個生態展覽在哪裡舉行？
展覽由哪一天開始，哪一天結束？
lv2: 為什麼舉辦生態展覽對學生和市民有幫助？
人類的哪些日常活動可能對生態環境造成影響？
lv3: 單靠展覽能否有效提升公眾的環保意識？除了展覽，政府和學校還可以採取哪些措施來保護生態環境？
有人認為經濟發展和生態保育難以兼顧，你認為兩者可以同時實現嗎？請提出你的理由及例子。

articles.title: 港鐵洪水橋新站採「平移建造法」　屯馬線添新站服務居民
articles.summary: 港鐵正在屯馬線天水圍站與兆康站之間加建全新的洪水橋站，工程採用創新的「平移建造法」進行。這種建造方式可以在不影響現有鐵路正常運作的情況下，逐步將新建結構移入指定位置。新站建成後，將大大方便洪水橋及附近一帶的居民出行，亦配合該區未來的發展規劃。港鐵表示，工程進展順利，預計落成後將進一步提升新界西北地區的交通網絡。

lv1: 洪水橋新站位於屯馬線的哪兩個站之間？
港鐵用了什麼特別方法來建造洪水橋站？
lv2: 為什麼在現有鐵路旁邊加建新站是一項工程挑戰？「平移建造法」如何幫助解決這個問題？
新的洪水橋站落成後，對當地居民的生活有什麼好處？
lv3: 香港不斷擴展鐵路網絡，有人認為應優先發展公共交通，減少私家車；也有人認為鐵路工程耗費龐大資源，未必值得。你認為持續擴展鐵路網絡對香港整體是利多於弊還是弊多於利？
交通基建的發展往往需要大量公帑投入。政府在決定興建新鐵路站時，應如何平衡不同地區居民的需求與整體社會資源的分配？
